rationale: The most recent 1-minute candle closed at $21.77, well below the entry price of $21.82, and price is now sitting below the 9-EMA ($21.78), negating the original bullish setup which required price to hold above that level. The maximum adverse excursion (-0.37%) already exceeds the maximum favorable excursion (0.18%), indicating the trade has not moved in the intended direction since entry, and with only 23 minutes to close and no catalysts, the risk/reward of holding has deteriorated materially relative to the original thesis.
